data.description:
As an operator, I want CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md updated with telemetry config keys and INSTALL.md updated with AWS setup instructions, so that teams can deploy and operate the telemetry infrastructure without reading source code.

## What / Why / Scope

Update two reference documents to cover the new telemetry infrastructure shipped in the d2f9 epic:
1. CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md — add all new telemetry config keys (endpoint URL, S3 bucket name, enabled flag, privacy settings)
2. INSTALL.md — add a "Telemetry Infrastructure" section covering aws-setup-bucket.sh, aws-setup-lambda.sh, aws-verify-live.sh, and aws-teardown.sh invocations with prerequisites and expected outputs

Out of scope: CLAUDE.md edits (Gate 5 not satisfied — telemetry config is not an every-session orchestrator rule).

## Done Definitions

- CONFIGURATION-REFERENCE.md includes all new telemetry config keys introduced by d2f9 (at minimum: telemetry.endpoint_url, telemetry.s3_bucket_name, telemetry.enabled) with types, defaults, and one-line descriptions ← Satisfies: sc-1, sc-5
- INSTALL.md includes a "Telemetry Infrastructure" section covering aws-setup-bucket.sh → aws-setup-lambda.sh → aws-verify-live.sh invocation sequence with prerequisites (AWS credentials, DuckDB) and expected output ← Satisfies: sc-1, sc-10
- Story completion report includes DOC_ROUTER_ATTESTATION block (gate fired, target file, CLAUDE.md edited: no) ← Satisfies: sc-6

## Considerations

[Accuracy] Doc content must be derived from implemented scripts/config keys — never from this story description, which may not reflect final implementation details.
[Scope] Any CLAUDE.md edits must go through CLAUDE_MD_SUGGESTED_CHANGE report process, NOT direct edits.

## Escalation Policy

Escalate when blocked
